CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFMAIL

CFMAIL builds a message from its attributes and the text between its start and end tags, then hands it to the KoldFusion mail spooler for delivery by SMTP. The body works like CFOUTPUT: CFML expressions between pound signs are evaluated, and with a QUERY attribute the message is sent once for every row.

Category

Internet protocols

Syntax

<CFMAIL TO="recipient"
    FROM="sender"
    CC="copy_to"
    BCC="blind_copy_to"
    SUBJECT="msg_subject"
    TYPE="HTML"
    MAXROWS="max_msgs"
    MIMEATTACH="path"
    QUERY="query_name"
    GROUP="query_column"
    STARTROW="query_row"
    SERVER="servername"
    PORT="port_ID"
    MAILERID="headerid"
    TIMEOUT="seconds">
  message text
</CFMAIL>

Attributes

TO
Required. Recipient address. Several addresses can be separated by commas. With QUERY, usually a column name such as #Email#.
FROM
Required. Sender address.
SUBJECT
Required. Subject line. May contain expressions.
CC
Optional. Addresses that receive a copy.
BCC
Optional. Addresses that receive a blind copy; they are not listed in the message headers.
TYPE
Optional. HTML sends the body as text/html instead of plain text.
QUERY
Optional. Name of a query. One message is sent per row (or per group, see GROUP), and the columns can be used in every attribute and in the body.
GROUP
Optional. Query column to group on. One message is sent per group; a nested CFOUTPUT in the body loops over the rows of the group. The query should be sorted on this column.
STARTROW
Optional, default "1". First query row to send.
MAXROWS
Optional. Maximum number of messages to send.
MIMEATTACH
Optional. Full path of a file to attach.
SERVER
Optional. SMTP server. Defaults to the server set on the Mail page of the KoldFusion Administrator.
PORT
Optional. SMTP port. Defaults to the port set in the Administrator, normally 25.
MAILERID
Optional, default "KoldFusion Application Server". Value of the X-Mailer header.
TIMEOUT
Optional. Seconds to wait for the SMTP server. Defaults to the Administrator setting (60).

Usage

CFMAIL never waits for the SMTP server. Each message is written to mail/spool under the KoldFusion install directory, and a background thread delivers the spool at the interval set in the Administrator. Messages that cannot be delivered are moved to mail/undelivr and noted in the mail log. An empty TO or FROM throws an Application exception straight away.

Use CFMAILPARAM to add attachments and custom headers. Remember that # inside the body starts an expression: write ## for a literal pound sign.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- One message per Training employee, all addressed to a harmless local mailbox --->
<CFQUERY NAME="Trainers" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Employees
WHERE Department = 'Training' ORDER BY LastName
</CFQUERY>

<CFMAIL QUERY="Trainers"
        TO="someone@localhost"
        FROM="webmaster@localhost"
        SUBJECT="Course schedule for #FirstName# #LastName#">
Hello #FirstName#,

The spring course schedule is now on the intranet.
(In real life this message would go to #Email#.)

-- The KoldFusion mail robot
</CFMAIL>

<CFOUTPUT><P>Spooled #Trainers.RecordCount# messages:</P></CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>To</TH><TH>Subject</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Trainers">
<TR><TD>someone@localhost</TD><TD>Course schedule for #FirstName# #LastName#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
